summary: Accuray Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the maturity and full repayment of its 3.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2026 on June 1, 2026. The remaining outstanding principal of $18 million plus accrued interest of $337,500 was paid in cash, satisfying and discharging the indenture. This is a routine debt maturity and repayment, not a special situation transaction. There is no deal, premium, or strategic event; the filing simply notes the termination of a material definitive agreement upon repayment. No risk-arb angle applies.
